problem: "This halves the independent coefficients" is loose. For real x[n] the independent real numbers are X[0], plus X[N/2] when N is even, plus (N/2 − 1) conjugate pairs: that is N/2 + 1 real numbers, not N/2.
fix: "For even N this leaves N/2 + 1 independent real numbers: X[0], X[N/2], and N/2 − 1 conjugate pairs."

problem: "Only k = 0, …, N−1 are new" is unclear — 'new' has no meaning here; the point is that these are the only distinct (independent) harmonics.
fix: "Only k = 0, …, N−1 give distinct frequencies; every other k repeats one of them."

problem: "lets N go to infinity and replaces the finite sum with the DTFT" can leave a student thinking the DTFT only applies to periodic sequences with very large period. The DTFT is the transform of an aperiodic sequence.
fix: "Chapter 6.2 treats an aperiodic sequence by letting the period grow without limit, and the finite DTFS sum becomes the DTFT integral-free sum over all n."
